title: Uniform probability of an event
statement: For every $n\ge 0$ and every predicate $P$ on $\{-1,1\}^n$, the probability of the event $\{x:P(x)\}$ under the uniform distribution on the sign cube equals the uniform probability of $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on the sign cube
